reviews.text: Nice and welcoming staff, very knowledgeable.

Professional veterinarians
I used my cat when there were skin symptoms and hair loss, so a swab sample was taken from the skin, the ears were examined
photographed where the hair was coming from.
Very calm veterinarian and treats the cat nicely and gently
Expensive service. Requires your own car to get there, because it's a bit far from the main roads
Good size place and several veterinarians on site. I highly recommend it.
In a special place, but the staff and service are first class. We received a lot of information about upcoming treatments/options. Highly recommended ❤️

Tähti the cat is not very grateful now.🤢We had to rinse twice because Katja didn't think ANTIBIOTICS were necessary the first time. Cat vet did say when she sent the referral that there would be a course of treatment. Well, three days went by and the right operated ear was oozing pus. We went again...then there was nothing we could do but give an antibiotic course and add cortisone.and let it calm down. And rinse again..Well this time the right ear didn't turn red after the procedure and there was no visible discharge.(Like the first rinse)
..However, I had to call and ask for an increase in the antibiotic...
..(then the prescription went to the wrong pharmacy)
Well, there was another call and a rush.
Well then I had to ask for more cortisone and a prescription. Well, it didn't come to the pharmacy. But by mail. And when I went to the pharmacy with it, there was also a mistake.
Luckily, there was a wonderful pharmacist who called Aureen and got the necessary information and I got cortisone from the pharmacy
Next Thursday we'll go to the vet with Cat for a check-up....We'll see if the hole Katja made in the eardrum has grown closed...etc.
...
More information about Tähte.
The doctor changed. Jonna Juhola now treated Tähte.
A big thank you.❤️
A big lump was removed in front of the eardrum.
The medicine was changed to "EYE DROPS in the ear"
..
Well, now we'll see how it goes. This little guy will probably take cortisone for the rest of his life. (6 years) We've already tried to rule out food allergies...
..
Otherwise, really nice service at Aureen. But if the cat hadn't had insurance...this whole brace treatment with all the bells and whistles...would have cost many thousands of euros.
Now with a deductible. Quite enough...And according to the new guidelines, insurance will only cover the previous ones once a year.
I'm just saying that it's always worth thinking before you get an animal..That its living expenses are not a small thing. And animals should be taken care of properly, if you have one.❤️🙏❤️🐱
I have been very satisfied with the service and the care my cat received.

The dog underwent video otoscopy, ear irrigation and CBCT imaging. The procedure was performed perfectly and at the end, recorded videos of the procedures were shown. Everything went as planned and the staff told, explained and instructed to act as the situation required.
The downside was that the treatment was expensive, but after all, treating a pet would have been cheap.
This clinic exudes expertise. The staff is always friendly and the appointments are unhurried ❤️
Valuable transaction. Of course, the price information is clearly displayed online.
Dog skin problems can be tackled here 🤩 …
A very pleasant experience. Dogs are taken into consideration.

We went all the way from Lahe with Kessu the cat to have her ear problems treated. I can only warmly recommend the place, really professional and animal-loving, with friendly staff, you can tell they are in the right field. ❤️
Expert and top-notch service.

Due to the dog's long-lasting ear infection symptoms, we finally went to Aures. Absolutely great service and the investigation started to progress quickly! If you have skin or ear problems, I highly recommend Sakke Villis and the staff.
Top professionals. And every single one of them was friendly. They understood the dog's excitement and encouraged him nicely. The impression was that it was good to work here, good team spirit.

Highly professional and well caring team of veterinarians and nurses. Taking a lot of time and using all their energy to treat their animal patients, but also are there for their humans equally. The human healthcare system should be just like that.
Thank you for taking care of Hachiko
Seeking help for furuncles on the hair shaft and redness and inflammation on the paws. Check-ups will continue until the paws are fixed. Nice and approachable staff☺️
Best
Good professional service

A very good experience. My dog, who is very nervous about the doctor, accepted treats for the first time at the reception. The veterinarian greeted us "on the floor", which I thought was a wonderful approach. We were listened to calmly - I can't emphasize this too much, I've been to stations for so long where they treat several patients at the same time, and there's no time to focus on examining one patient properly at a time. Another important thing for me and the dog - we were on time, even early. At the other station you always have to wait at least 15 minutes, which is really stressful for the animal. We received advice and were able to move forward in treating the dog's itching and allergy.

Having been here several times for my dog's ear problems, I can warmly recommend it: really high-quality, friendly service (on behalf of the entire staff) and care that is justified to the owner and the dog is treated with certainty. I have already recommended Aure to several people 💕 …
Specialized animal care expertise

Luckily I found you here! After years of being paralyzed by different vets due to paw problems, Oiva finally got proper examinations and the right kind of treatment here. Thank you very much for the very professional, good and dog-friendly service, we will definitely come again if needed! Both the owner and the dog are very grateful that life became so much easier because of your expertise 💕
Dog didn't even noticed for being doctored 👍🐕 Not cheap place, but apparently just great ✨️ …
Professional and friendly service 😊 …

Very competent vet who knew how to approach a dog who is afraid of having his ears touched. I got really good advice on how to accustom a little boy who always runs away when I try to put ear medicine in, step by step treatment. Full marks for this.
Very professional staff, but expensive. No real waiting area, so it's worth going only when your time is near. Poor parking due to roadworks.

Well, as mostly everyone knows, vets and specially in Finland are super expensive... If you don't have an insurance... You will lose a kidney and probably more... However going to the quality of service, results and attention to our little family members... You won't go wrong to visit and treat your dog with the staff of Aures... They are very organized, gentle and informative.. it is expensive, yes.. but they are very good.
Expert veterinarian😃 …
Absolute number one in the treatment of dog skin and ear problems. Excellent help was obtained and the cause of recurrent ear infections was discovered.
Excellent service and expert care for your pet.
Excellent and professional service. Thank you.

The atmosphere is quiet and peaceful. No unnecessary noise, even though patients and their owners come and go in and out of the reception area. Pleasant and empathetic staff. There is no sense of rush at the reception area.

From Pirkanmaa, recommended by a local orthopedist, we were sent to see a specialist. Balance: 10 times the price, same stories as the local vet! The only thing new was a change in medication. 1 hour, the doctor was there for about 35 minutes, he kept checking his cell phone every now and then and then he was gone because he was in a hurry. 😡😡
Expert and caring staff. ❤️
